title: Dragon Copter
content: (Video link)Festohas built a working model ornithopter called a BionicOpter. Like the dragonfly it is based on, it can fly in all directions, hover in mid-air, and glide.I have always been fascinated by the idea of dragonfly ornithopters. Here is Arthur Denison's steam-powered dragoncopter fromDinotopia: The World Beneath(1995). Even though the dragonfly is a very ancient design, it's one of the most agile fliers among insects.(link to video) The aerodynamics are suggested in this computer simulation from Wright State University.-----Thanks, Luke DavisPreviously on GJ:Insect VehiclesButterfly ornithopter
